electroball.name: Electro Ball
electroball.shortDesc: More power the faster the user is than the target.
electroball.desc: The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 150 if the result is 4 or more, 120 if 3, 80 if 2, 60 if 1, 40 if less than 1. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 40.

entrainment.name: Entrainment
entrainment.shortDesc: The target's Ability changes to match the user's.
entrainment.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

finalgambit.name: Final Gambit
finalgambit.shortDesc: Does damage equal to the user's HP. User faints.
finalgambit.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's current HP. If this move is successful, the user faints.

firepledge.name: Fire Pledge
firepledge.shortDesc: Use with Grass or Water Pledge for added effect.
firepledge.desc: If one of the user's allies chose to use Grass Pledge or Water Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Fire Pledge with 150 power and a sea of fire appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which causes damage to non-Fire types equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn. If combined with Water Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Fire Gem.

frostbreath.name: Frost Breath

hex.name: Hex

If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.

incinerate.name: Incinerate
incinerate.desc: The target loses its held item if it is a Berry or a Gem. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

quickguard.shortDesc: Protects allies from priority attacks this turn.

This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

ragepowder.name: Rage Powder
ragepowder.shortDesc: The foes' moves target the user on the turn used.
ragepowder.desc: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

relicsong.name: Relic Song

Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.

voltswitch.name: Volt Switch

Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, if the target is preparing to use Beak Blast, Focus Punch, or Shell Trap, or if the move is Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Ice Ball, Instruct, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Obstruct, Outrage, Petal Dance, Rollout, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Thrash, Transform, Uproar, Wicked Torque, any two-turn move, or any recharge move.

lightthatburnsthesky.desc: This move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes. This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

mindblown.desc: Whether or not this move is successful and even if it would cause fainting, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard Ability. This move is prevented from executing and the user does not lose HP if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability, or if this move is Fire type and the user is affected by Powder or the weather is Primordial Sea.

multiattack.name: Multi-Attack

naturesmadness.name: Nature's Madness

neverendingnightmare.name: Never-Ending Nightmare

psychicterrain.name: Psychic Terrain
psychicterrain.desc: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Psychic-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot be hit by moves with priority greater than 0, unless the target is an ally. Camouflage transforms the user into a Psychic type, Nature Power becomes Psychic, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Psychic Terrain.

This move is typeless if the user's type is typeless alone.

shoreup.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half down. If the weather is Sandstorm, the user instead restores 2/3 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.

sizzlyslide.name: Sizzly Slide
sizzlyslide.desc: Has a 100% chance to burn the foe.

solarblade.name: Solar Blade
solarblade.shortDesc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.
solarblade.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Hail, Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move still requires a turn to charge.

sparklyswirl.name: Sparkly Swirl
sparklyswirl.shortDesc: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.
sparklyswirl.desc: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition.

splinteredstormshards.name: Splintered Stormshards
splinteredstormshards.desc: Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.

spotlight.name: Spotlight
spotlight.shortDesc: Target's foes' moves are redirected to it this turn.
spotlight.desc: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from opponents of the target are redirected to the target. Such attacks are redirected to the target before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal.

anchorshot.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field.

auroraveil.name: Aurora Veil
auroraveil.shortDesc: For 5 turns, damage to allies halved. Snow only.
auroraveil.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Hail.

brutalswing.name: Brutal Swing
brutalswing.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

burnup.name: Burn Up

laserfocus.shortDesc: Until the end of the next turn, user's moves crit.

powertrip.name: Power Trip
powertrip.shortDesc: + 20 power for each of the user's stat boosts.
powertrip.desc: Power is equal to 20+(X*20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.

prismaticlaser.name: Prismatic Laser
prismaticlaser.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

psychicfangs.name: Psychic Fangs
psychicfangs.shortDesc: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.
psychicfangs.desc: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.

purify.name: Purify
purify.shortDesc: Cures target's status; heals user 1/2 max HP if so.
purify.desc: The target is cured if it has a non-volatile status condition. If the target was cured, the user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

shelltrap.name: Shell Trap
shelltrap.shortDesc: User must take physical damage before moving.
shelltrap.desc: Fails unless the user is hit by a physical attack from an opponent this turn before it can execute the move. If the user was hit and has not fainted, it attacks immediately after being hit, and the effect ends. If the opponent's physical attack had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability, it does not count for the purposes of this effect.

smartstrike.name: Smart Strike
smartstrike.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

spectralthief.desc: The target's stat stages greater than 0 are stolen from it and applied to the user before dealing damage.

speedswap.name: Speed Swap
speedswap.desc: The user swaps its Speed stat with the target. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

spiritshackle.name: Spirit Shackle

If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field.

A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.

strengthsap.name: Strength Sap
strengthsap.shortDesc: User heals HP=target's Atk stat. Lowers Atk by 1.
strengthsap.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage. The user restores its HP equal to the target's Attack stat calculated with its stat stage before this move was used. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. Fails if the target's Attack stat stage is -6.

sunsteelstrike.name: Sunsteel Strike
sunsteelstrike.shortDesc: Ignores the Abilities of other Pokemon.
sunsteelstrike.desc: This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

tearfullook.name: Tearful Look
tearfullook.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.
tearfullook.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.

astralbarrage.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

aurawheel.name: Aura Wheel
aurawheel.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage. If the user is a Morpeko in Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. If the user is a Morpeko in Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Full Belly or Hangry Mode Morpeko.

bodypress.name: Body Press
bodypress.shortDesc: Uses user's Def stat as Atk in damage calculation.
bodypress.desc: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Attack stat are used as normal.

boltbeak.name: Bolt Beak
boltbeak.shortDesc: Power doubles if user moves before the target.
boltbeak.desc: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

breakingswipe.name: Breaking Swipe
breakingswipe.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Attack by 1.
breakingswipe.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

burningjealousy.name: Burning Jealousy
burningjealousy.shortDesc: 100% burns a target that had a stat rise this turn.
burningjealousy.desc: Has a 100% chance to burn the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.

clangoroussoul.name: Clangorous Soul
clangoroussoul.shortDesc: User loses 33% of its max HP. +1 to all stats.
clangoroussoul.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage in exchange for the user losing 33% of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stat stages would not change.

coaching.name: Coaching
coaching.shortDesc: Raises an ally's Attack and Defense by 1.
coaching.desc: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

corrosivegas.name: Corrosive Gas
corrosivegas.desc: The target loses its held item. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item or cause a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, a Silvally, a Zacian, or a Zamazenta to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, or Rusted Shield respectively. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

courtchange.name: Court Change
courtchange.shortDesc: Swaps user's field effects with the opposing side.
courtchange.desc: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.

decorate.name: Decorate
decorate.shortDesc: Raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 2.
decorate.desc: Raises the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.

dragondarts.name: Dragon Darts
dragondarts.shortDesc: Hits twice. Doubles: Tries to hit each foe once.
dragondarts.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. In Double Battles, this move attempts to hit the targeted Pokemon and its ally once each. If hitting one of these Pokemon would be prevented by immunity, protection, semi-invulnerability, an Ability, or accuracy, it attempts to hit the other Pokemon twice instead. If this move is redirected, it hits that target twice.

dragonenergy.name: Dragon Energy
dragonenergy.shortDesc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).
dragonenergy.desc: Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

drumbeating.name: Drum Beating
drumbeating.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
drumbeating.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

expandingforce.name: Expanding Force

expandingforce.desc: If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.

falsesurrender.name: False Surrender

flipturn.name: Flip Turn
flipturn.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.
flipturn.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

freezingglare.name: Freezing Glare
freezingglare.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

glaciallance.name: Glacial Lance
glaciallance.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

gmaxbefuddle.name: G-Max Befuddle
gmaxbefuddle.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: slp or psn or par.
gmaxbefuddle.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side either falls asleep, becomes poisoned, or becomes paralyzed, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxcentiferno.name: G-Max Centiferno
gmaxcentiferno.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: bound 4-5 turns.
gmaxcentiferno.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side is prevented from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw), even if they have a substitute. Causes damage equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. They can still switch out if they are holding Shed Shell or use Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends for a target if it leaves the field, or if it uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

gmaxcannonade.name: G-Max Cannonade
gmaxcannonade.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1/6 HP, 4 turns.
gmaxcannonade.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, for 4 turns each non-Water-type Pokemon on the opposing side takes damage equal to 1/6 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn.

gmaxchistrike.name: G-Max Chi Strike
gmaxchistrike.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Allies: Crit Ratio +1.
gmaxchistrike.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the user's side has their critical hit ratio raised by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxcuddle.name: G-Max Cuddle
gmaxcuddle.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: infatuated.
gmaxcuddle.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side becomes infatuated, even if they have a substitute. This effect does not happen for a target if both it and the user are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated.

gmaxdepletion.name: G-Max Depletion
gmaxdepletion.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: last move -2 PP.
gmaxdepletion.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side loses 2 PP from its last move used, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxdrumsolo.name: G-Max Drum Solo
gmaxdrumsolo.desc: Power is 160 regardless of the base move's Max Move power. This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

gmaxfireball.name: G-Max Fireball

gmaxfinale.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/6 of its current maximum HP, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxfoamburst.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -2 Speed.
gmaxfoamburst.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the Speed of each Pokemon on the opposing side is lowered by 2 stages, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxgoldrush.name: G-Max Gold Rush

gmaxhydrosnipe.name: G-Max Hydrosnipe

gmaxmalodor.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side becomes poisoned, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxmeltdown.name: G-Max Meltdown
gmaxmeltdown.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: Tormented.
gmaxmeltdown.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Torment begins for each Pokemon on the opposing side, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxoneblow.name: G-Max One Blow
gmaxoneblow.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Bypasses Max Guard.
gmaxoneblow.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. This move bypasses all protection effects, including Max Guard.

gmaxrapidflow.name: G-Max Rapid Flow
gmaxrapidflow.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Bypasses Max Guard.
gmaxrapidflow.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. This move bypasses all protection effects, including Max Guard.

gmaxreplenish.name: G-Max Replenish
gmaxreplenish.shortDesc: Base move affects power. 50% restores Berries.
gmaxreplenish.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, there is a 50% chance every Pokemon on the user's side has its Berry restored, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxresonance.name: G-Max Resonance
gmaxresonance.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Allies: Aurora Veil.

mistyexplosion.shortDesc: User faints. User on Misty Terrain: 1.5x power.

noretreat.name: No Retreat

obstruct.name: Obstruct
obstruct.shortDesc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: -2 Def.
obstruct.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Defense lowered by 2 stages. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. scaleshot.shortDesc: Hits 2-5 times. User: -1 Def, +1 Spe after last hit.
scaleshot.desc: Hits two to five times. Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage and raises the user's Speed by 1 stage after the last hit. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

shellsidearm.name: Shell Side Arm
shellsidearm.shortDesc: 20% psn. Physical+contact if it would be stronger.
shellsidearm.desc: Has a 20% chance to poison the target. This move becomes a physical attack that makes contact if the value of ((((2 * the user's level / 5 + 2) * 90 * X) / Y) / 50), where X is the user's Attack stat and Y is the target's Defense stat, is greater than the same value where X is the user's Special Attack stat and Y is the target's Special Defense stat. No stat modifiers other than stat stage changes are considered for this purpose. If the two values are equal, this move chooses a damage category at random.

snaptrap.name: Snap Trap
snaptrap.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
snaptrap.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

terrainpulse.name: Terrain Pulse
terrainpulse.shortDesc: User on terrain: power doubles, type varies.
terrainpulse.desc: Power doubles if the user is grounded and a terrain is active, and this move's type changes to match. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain.

tripleaxel.name: Triple Axel
tripleaxel.shortDesc: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.
tripleaxel.desc: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.

wickedblow.name: Wicked Blow
wickedblow.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit.
wickedblow.desc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

stuffcheeks.shortDesc: Must hold Berry to use. User eats Berry, Def +2.

tarshot.name: Tar Shot

tarshot.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it.

teatime.shortDesc: All active Pokemon consume held Berries.

If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.

This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

wavecrash.name: Wave Crash
wavecrash.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

ceaselessedge.name: Ceaseless Edge
ceaselessedge.shortDesc: Sets a layer of Spikes on the opposing side.
ceaselessedge.desc: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. A maximum of three layers may be set, and opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

bleakwindstorm.name: Bleakwind Storm
bleakwindstorm.shortDesc: 30% to lower foe(s) Speed by 1. Rain: can't miss.
bleakwindstorm.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.

wildboltstorm.name: Wildbolt Storm
wildboltstorm.shortDesc: 20% chance to paralyze foe(s). Rain: can't miss.
wildboltstorm.desc: Has a 20% chance to paralyze the target. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.

sandsearstorm.name: Sandsear Storm
sandsearstorm.shortDesc: 20% chance to burn foe(s). Can't miss in rain.
sandsearstorm.desc: Has a 20% chance to burn the target. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.

springtidestorm.name: Springtide Storm

lunarblessing.desc: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up, and has its status condition cured.

takeheart.name: Take Heart

takeheart.desc: The user cures its non-volatile status condition. Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.

absorb.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

acid.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the foe(s) Sp. Def by 1.
acid.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

bide.name: Bide
bide.shortDesc: Waits 2 turns; deals double the damage taken.
bide.desc: The user spends two turns locked into this move and then, on the second turn after using this move, the user attacks the last Pokemon that hit it, inflicting double the damage in HP it lost to attacks during the two turns. If the last Pokemon that hit it is no longer active, the user attacks a random opposing Pokemon instead. If the user is prevented from moving during this move's use, the effect ends. This move does not check accuracy and does not ignore type immunity.

bind.name: Bind
bind.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
bind.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

bite.name: Bite
bite.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
bite.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.shortDesc: 10% chance to freeze foe(s). Can't miss in Snow.
blizzard.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.

bonemerang.name: Bonemerang
bonemerang.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

bubble.name: Bubble
bubble.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.
bubble.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

bubblebeam.name: Bubble Beam
bubblebeam.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
bubblebeam.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

clamp.name: Clamp
clamp.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
clamp.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

cometpunch.name: Comet Punch
cometpunch.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

constrict.name: Constrict
constrict.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
constrict.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

conversion.name: Conversion
conversion.shortDesc: Changes user's type to match its first move.
conversion.desc: The user's type changes to match the original type of the move in its first move slot. Fails if the user cannot change its type, or if the type is one of the user's current types.

counter.name: Counter
counter.shortDesc: If hit by physical attack, returns double damage.
counter.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical attack this turn.

crabhammer.name: Crabhammer
crabhammer.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

defensecurl.name: Defense Curl
defensecurl.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage. As long as the user remains active, the power of the user's Ice Ball and Rollout will be doubled (this effect is not stackable).

dig.name: Dig
dig.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Earthquake and Magnitude but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

disable.name: Disable
disable.shortDesc: For 4 turns, disables the target's last move used.
disable.desc: For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Max or G-Max Move.

dizzypunch.name: Dizzy Punch
dizzypunch.desc: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

doubleedge.name: Double-Edge
doubleedge.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

doublekick.name: Double Kick

earthquake.name: Earthquake

fissure.name: Fissure
fissure.shortDesc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.
fissure.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

fly.name: Fly
fly.shortDesc: Flies up on first turn, then strikes the next turn.
fly.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

focusenergy.name: Focus Energy
focusenergy.shortDesc: Raises the user's critical hit ratio by 2.
focusenergy.desc: Raises the user's chance for a critical hit by 2 stages. Fails if the user already has the effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

furyattack.name: Fury Attack
furyattack.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. furyswipes.name: Fury Swipes
furyswipes.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. haze.desc: Resets the stat stages of all active Pokemon to 0.

highjumpkick.name: High Jump Kick
highjumpkick.shortDesc: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.
highjumpkick.desc: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.

horndrill.name: Horn Drill
horndrill.shortDesc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.
horndrill.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

hyperbeam.name: Hyper Beam
hyperbeam.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

jumpkick.name: Jump Kick
jumpkick.shortDesc: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.
jumpkick.desc: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.

karatechop.name: Karate Chop
karatechop.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

leechseed.name: Leech Seed
leechseed.shortDesc: 1/8 of target's HP is restored to user every turn.
leechseed.desc: The Pokemon at the user's position steals 1/8 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. If Big Root is held by the recipient, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue being leeched. If the target switches out or uses Mortal Spin or Rapid Spin successfully, the effect ends. Grass-type Pokemon are immune to this move on use, but not its effect.

lightscreen.name: Light Screen
lightscreen.shortDesc: For 5 turns, special damage to allies is halved.
lightscreen.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.shortDesc: The last move the target used replaces this one.
mimic.desc: While the user remains active, this move is replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has the maximum PP for that move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, if the user already knows the move, or if the move is Assist, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Hold Hands, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Tera Starstorm, Transform, or Wicked Torque.

minimize.name: Minimize
minimize.desc: Raises the user's evasiveness by 2 stages. Whether or not the user's evasiveness was changed, Body Slam, Dragon Rush, Flying Press, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Malicious Moonsault, Steamroller, and Stomp will not check accuracy and have their damage doubled if used against the user while it is active.

mirrormove.name: Mirror Move
mirrormove.shortDesc: User uses the target's last used move against it.
mirrormove.desc: The user uses the last move used by the target. The copied move is used against that target, if possible. Fails if the target has not made a move, or if the last move used cannot be copied by this move.

mist.name: Mist
mist.shortDesc: For 5 turns, protects user's party from stat drops.
mist.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members are protected from having their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

nightshade.name: Night Shade
nightshade.shortDesc: Does damage equal to the user's level.
nightshade.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.

petaldance.name: Petal Dance
petaldance.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.
petaldance.desc: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

pinmissile.name: Pin Missile
pinmissile.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

poisonsting.name: Poison Sting
poisonsting.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

psywave.name: Psywave
psywave.shortDesc: Random damage equal to 0.5x-1.5x user's level.
psywave.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to (user's level) * (X + 50) / 100, where X is a random number from 0 to 100, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

rage.name: Rage
rage.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 if hit during use.
rage.desc: Once this move is successfully used, the user's Attack is raised by 1 stage every time it is hit by another Pokemon's attack as long as this move is chosen for use.

razorleaf.name: Razor Leaf
razorleaf.shortDesc: High critical hit ratio. Hits adjacent foes.
razorleaf.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

razorwind.name: Razor Wind
razorwind.shortDesc: Charges, then hits foe(s) turn 2. High crit ratio.
razorwind.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

recover.name: Recover
recover.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
recover.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.shortDesc: For 5 turns, physical damage to allies is halved.
reflect.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

rest.name: Rest
rest.shortDesc: User sleeps 2 turns and restores HP and status.
rest.desc: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.

roar.name: Roar
roar.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
roar.desc: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.

rockslide.name: Rock Slide
rockslide.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.
rockslide.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

sandattack.name: Sand Attack
sandattack.desc: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

seismictoss.name: Seismic Toss
seismictoss.shortDesc: Does damage equal to the user's level.
seismictoss.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.

selfdestruct.desc: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

skullbash.name: Skull Bash
skullbash.shortDesc: Raises user's Defense by 1 on turn 1. Hits turn 2.
skullbash.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

slash.name: Slash
slash.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

sludge.name: Sludge

softboiled.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

solarbeam.name: Solar Beam
solarbeam.shortDesc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.
solarbeam.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move still requires a turn to charge.

sonicboom.name: Sonic Boom
sonicboom.desc: Deals 20 HP of damage to the target.

spikecannon.name: Spike Cannon
spikecannon.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

stomp.name: Stomp
stomp.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
stomp.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

struggle.name: Struggle
struggle.shortDesc: User loses 1/4 of its max HP.
struggle.desc: Deals typeless damage to a random opposing Pokemon. If this move was successful, the user loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up, and the Rock Head Ability does not prevent this. This move is automatically used if none of the user's known moves can be selected.

submission.name: Submission
submission.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.shortDesc: User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.
substitute.desc: The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. The substitute is removed once enough damage is inflicted on it, or if the user switches out or faints. Baton Pass can be used to transfer the substitute to an ally, and the substitute will keep its remaining HP. Until the substitute is broken, it receives damage from all attacks made by other Pokemon and shields the user from status effects and stat stage changes caused by other Pokemon. Sound-based moves and Pokemon with the Infiltrator Ability ignore substitutes. The user still takes normal damage from weather and status effects while behind its substitute. If the substitute breaks during a multi-hit attack, the user will take damage from any remaining hits. If a substitute is created while the user is trapped by a binding move, the binding effect ends immediately. Fails if the user does not have enough HP remaining to create a substitute without fainting, or if it already has a substitute.

superfang.name: Super Fang
superfang.shortDesc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.
superfang.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

swift.name: Swift
swift.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy. Hits foes.
swift.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

takedown.name: Take Down
takedown.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.
thrash.desc: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.shortDesc: 30% chance to paralyze. Can't miss in rain.
thunder.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.

thunderwave.name: Thunder Wave
thunderwave.desc: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.

transform.name: Transform
transform.shortDesc: Copies target's stats, moves, types, and Ability.
transform.desc: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.

triattack.name: Tri Attack
triattack.shortDesc: 20% chance to paralyze or burn or freeze target.
triattack.desc: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

twineedle.name: Twineedle
twineedle.shortDesc: Hits 2 times. Each hit has 20% chance to poison.
twineedle.desc: Hits twice, with each hit having a 20% chance to poison the target. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
whirlwind.desc: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
wrap.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

growl.name: Growl
growl.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

leer.name: Leer
leer.desc: Lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage.

lowkick.name: Low Kick
lowkick.shortDesc: More power the heavier the target.
lowkick.desc: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.

skyattack.name: Sky Attack
skyattack.shortDesc: Charges, then hits turn 2. 30% flinch. High crit.
skyattack.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch and a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

stringshot.name: String Shot
stringshot.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

surf.name: Surf
surf.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dive.
surf.desc: Damage doubles if the target is using Dive.

tailwhip.name: Tail Whip
tailwhip.desc: Lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.shortDesc: Badly poisons the target. Poison types can't miss.
toxic.desc: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.

flash.desc: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

hypnosis.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

leechlife.name: Leech Life
leechlife.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
leechlife.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

megadrain.name: Mega Drain
megadrain.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
megadrain.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

waterfall.name: Waterfall

waterfall.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

bodyslam.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

thunderbolt.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

boneclub.shortDesc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.
boneclub.desc: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

rollingkick.name: Rolling Kick
rollingkick.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
rollingkick.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 stage.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

agility.name: Agility
agility.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.

confuseray.name: Confuse Ray
confuseray.desc: Causes the target to become confused.

confusion.name: Confusion
confusion.desc: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.

doubleteam.name: Double Team
doubleteam.desc: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1 stage.

ember.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

firepunch.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
